messages:
Maya Chen: Kicked off long-context sweep (2k & 4k) for Mistral-Inst-7B and Llama-2-13B across H100/A100 in us-east1/us-west2/eu-west1. Mix: 60% chat (short turn), 40% batch (long generation). Goal: prefill shock, decode tails, and $/1M with q4/q8/fp16.

Jorge Alvarez: drop the compact table pls, will paste to the perf board.

Maya Chen: pasted condensed results (prefill includes KV transfer + first decode token). seq = 2048/4096 rows indicate which seqlen used.

```
model                 gpu   region   seq   kv_hit  prefill_p99  decode_p99  tok/s   $/1M
Mistral-Inst-7B       H100  us-east1 2048  50%     140ms        48ms        480k   $24.0
Mistral-Inst-7B       A100  us-east1 2048  50%     220ms        72ms        360k   $19.8
Mistral-Inst-7B       H100  us-east1 4096  30%     260ms        94ms        260k   $30.6
Mistral-Inst-7B       A100  us-east1 4096  30%     420ms       160ms        180k   $25.5
Llama-2-13B           H100  eu-west1 2048 40%     260ms       110ms        310k   $41.0
Llama-2-13B           A100  eu-west1 2048 40%     380ms       170ms        220k   $34.2
Llama-2-13B           H100  eu-west1 4096 25%     520ms       240ms        170k   $56.8
Llama-2-13B           A100  eu-west1 4096 25%     780ms       420ms        110k   $46.1
```

Liam O'Neill: H100 clearly wins p99 and decode tails especially at 4k. How measured tok/s and what concurrency?

Maya Chen: sustained concurrent streams: 20 for 7B at 2k, 8 for 7B at 4k; 12 for 13B at 2k, 6 at 4k. Sequence mix mean ~1200 tokens for 4k runs. tok/s shown are aggregate per-GPU steady-state numbers after 90s ramp.

Anika Rao: quantization regressions?

Maya Chen: eval harness (2k prompts, pairwise preference vs fp16):
- Mistral-Inst-7B q4_0: 2.1% pref drop
- Mistral-Inst-7B q8_0: 0.9% pref drop
- Llama-2-13B q4_0: 5.0% pref drop
- Llama-2-13B q8_0: 2.2% pref drop
Note: q4 shows larger impact on 13B scale; q8 is better quality but increases some kernel run times on A100.

Jorge Alvarez: any kernel anomalies in the sweep? last week we saw odd decode stalls with q4 on A100.

Maya Chen: yes. Observed decode stalls when scheduler selected kernel variant v3 on A100 for q4_0 at >2k seqlen. Tail looked like GC-ish stalls (decode p99 spiking). Forcing kernel v1 reduced decode_p99 by ~30% on affected runs.

Maya Chen: runner snippet we used to repro fallback:
```
./bench-sweep --model mistral-inst-7b --variant q4_0 --gpu a100 --region us-west2 \
  --seq 4096 --concurrency 8 --kernel-allow v1,v2,v3 --report prefill,decode,throughput --emit-telemetry
```

PerfBot: CSV uploaded by Maya 09876501 includes kernel, seqlen, kv_hit, prefill_ms, decode_ms, tokens_per_sec, cost_per_1m, kernel_choice, fallback_events. Link: https://internal.redwood/perf/3098765432/longcontext-sweep.csv :chart_with_upwards_trend:

OpsBot: note: us-west2 A100 rack-17 reported thermal-steer during long 4k runs; we observed intermittent frequency drops causing p99 variance. Ops opened ticket #OPS-1428 and scheduled a rack cooldown window.

Liam O'Neill: recommendation draft?

Maya Chen: for product teams: pin H100 for latency-sensitive, long-context reader endpoints (p99 SLOs). For bulk/throughput jobs where cost is primary, prefer A100 but add autoscale-to-H100 for canary/low-latency routes. Also: add a kernel-preference override for q4_0 on A100 to avoid v3 until kernel v3 has further fixes.

Anika Rao: ops playbook tweak?

Maya Chen: added: router should perform a KV-warmup probe for routes with >10% cold-prefill risk, and autoscaler should avoid scheduling >12 sustained 4k streams per A100 slot on racks with recent thermal-steer flags.

Jorge Alvarez: follow-up: can we run a 4k sweep with 70% KV-hit and q8_0 on A100/H100 to estimate warm-up benefits and cost delta? If someone can kick it off tomorrow morning I'll collect CSV and post.

Maya Chen: scheduled for 09:00 PT tomorrow. Will post results in a follow-up thread and open a small RFC to add kernel stickiness settings to the scheduler. :rocket:
